text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The 'strongest' Umamusume to conquer this battle is—
Mihono Bourbon—!"
(UWAAAAAAHH--!)

As Mihono Bourbon crossed the finish line,
an explosive roar of cheers enveloped her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha, ha...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon is the "strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Bourbon! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
............
Emotions――confirmation, analysis... Unknown.
As Mihono Bourbon looked up at the stands, tears began trickling down from her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master...!
choice_data_list: You really gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"T-Tears" will not stop.
Cause unknown. As for how to handle this—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Because... I'm "happy"...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Reporting in, Master.
I... have achieved 'victory'...っ!"

Until Mihono Bourbon stopped crying,
the applause across the racecourse didn't stop either.

—The next day. Mihono Bourbon's victory
was heavily featured in online news.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"—In the fiercely contested Arima Kinen,
Mihono Bourbon clinched a magnificent victory."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Below are excerpts from interviews
with the audience.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"‘She was originally a sprinter, you know.
Yet day in and day out, she worked so hard...!’"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "She proved to everyone that stamina can be built through pure effort, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Somehow... seeing them run with all their might made me feel like I need to try harder too!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Every spectator interviewed
spoke passionately about Mihono Bourbon."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "At first, everyone was skeptical. To our shame, the reporters of this magazine were no exception."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Yet she accomplished it.
She conquered 2,500 meters against the strongest field of them all."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"No one will ever
stand in her way again—"

Mihono Bourbon stared intently
at the article beneath her fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master, did I fulfill your order?

"The way you run has given courage to so many people."
As I continued, they smiled somewhat bashfully.

When I told her that the way she ran gave courage to many people,
she gave an embarrassed smile.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I feel a sense of 'pride'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please give me your next request,
Master.
And so, today as well, she dashed out onto the track.
